description: This file contains the PHP class definition for 'Credit', which is an extension of the Opencart system model related to total calculations within the catalog extension namespace. The class provides methods to calculate and manage customer credits as part of the order total process, including retrieving total credits, confirming transactions, and unconfirming them.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: A model class for handling customer credit adjustments within the total calculation extension namespace of Opencart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total credit available for the customer, applies it to reduce the order total, and logs the transaction if applicable.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms a credit transaction for an order and logs the transaction using the account transaction model.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes a credit transaction associated with an order, reversing the effect of the original credit confirmation.
